lines.en: Fixes the Demon Slayers with a gaze

lines.zh: 下弦之壹的脚步声，很轻。
lines.en: The footsteps of Lower One are very soft.

lines.zh: 太阳还没落，我不能走太快。
lines.en: The sun is still up. I can't move too fast.
Tastes its lips now and then
Glints with desire in its eyes

lines.zh: 睡吧，梦里我给你铺好路。
lines.en: Sleep; I have paved the road in your dreams.
Seems to be formulating a plan
Packed with hatred in its eyes

lines.zh: 感受魇梦的拥抱，梦里见！
lines.en: Feel Enmu's embrace, in dreams we meet.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的灵魂，梦魇之中！
lines.en: Devour your soul, in the nightmare!

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，你便属于魇梦！

lines.en: Dance in dreams, awaken to death!
Enmu's kiss, death in a dream!
In the mist, you fall asleep.

lines.zh: 梦境中的黑暗，吞噬一切！
梦魇之王，吞噬你的灵魂！
lines.en: King of nightmares, devour your soul!

lines.zh: 与魇梦的碰撞，就是死亡！
躲避魇梦的攻击，小心阳光！
lines.en: Dodge Enmu's attacks, beware the sun!
Collide with Enmu, meet your end!
Face Enmu, you can only flee!
Collide with Enmu, hanging by a thread!
Mate with Enmu, fall into darkness!

lines.zh: 成为魇梦之友，步入梦境！
lines.en: Become Enmu's friend, enter the dream!

lines.zh: 与魇梦为伍，灵魂归于梦魇！
lines.en: Be with Enmu, soul in the nightmare!

lines.zh: 与魇梦为伴，永不见天日！
lines.en: Mate with Enmu, never see the light!
Befriend Enmu, never wake from the dream!

lines.zh: 成为魇梦之友，共享梦魇！
lines.en: Become Enmu's friend, share the nightmare!

lines.zh: 魇梦的伴侣，步入永恒黑暗！

lines.en: Mate with Enmu, sink into the nightmare!

lines.zh: 睡吧，鬼杀队的刀会松手。
lines.en: Sleep, and your Demon Slayer blade will loosen.

lines.zh: 血鬼术一开，你就在梦里了。
lines.en: Once my Blood Demon Art starts, you're in a dream.
I know the smell of that uniform.
Muzan's blood whispers in my ear.

lines.zh: 梦里你连刀都拔不出来。
lines.en: In the dream you can't even draw your blade.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你的眼就闭上了。
lines.en: I count to three, and your eyes close.
I wait at the edge of your dream.
The way you struggle is lovely.
Pain in a dream remains after waking.

lines.zh: 我要让你做一场逃不掉的梦。
lines.en: I'll give you a dream you can't escape.

lines.zh: 队服的扣子，你会自己解开。

lines.en: I have teeth in the dream too.
The dream won't break before dawn.

lines.zh: 魇梦嘶吼，利爪撕裂黑夜。
lines.en: Enmu roars, claws tear through the night.

lines.zh: 鬼影闪避阳光，掠夺睡梦。
魇梦紧追不放，鬼杀队难逃。
lines.en: Enmu relentlessly pursues, the Ghostslayers cannot escape.

lines.zh: 魇梦挥舞黑影，吞噬生命。
lines.en: Enmu swings dark shadows, devouring life.

lines.zh: 魇梦吞噬梦境，永无安眠。
lines.en: Enmu devours dreams, never more rest.

lines.zh: 魇梦躲进阴影，远离日光。
lines.en: Enmu hides in shadows,避开阳光.
Ghostly blades do not harm Enmu, who grows more fierce.

lines.zh: 魇梦吞噬灵魂，死而复生。
lines.en: Enmu devours souls, rising from the dead.

lines.zh: 魇梦化梦为刃，刺穿心扉。
lines.en: Enmu turns dreams into blades, piercing hearts.
Sleep. There is no pain in the dream.
Your blade is in the dream now.

lines.zh: 我咬你的梦，不咬你的肉。
lines.en: I bite your dream, not your flesh.
Lower One feeds on good dreams.

lines.zh: 你睡着了，这场就结束了。
lines.en: Once you sleep, this is over.
Don't wake yet. The best part comes later.

lines.zh: 血鬼术，从你的眼皮开始。
lines.en: The art starts at your eyelids.
When sunlight comes, I'll switch dreams.
Under moonlight, Enmu appears in shadows.
Full moon night, Enmu wreaks havoc.

lines.zh: 夜里主世界的某个角落，我睁眼。
lines.en: Somewhere in the night overworld, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 一只就够了，我不需要同伴。
lines.en: One is enough. I need no company.
The moon is still low. I'll wait.
A demon's breath stirs in the grass.

lines.zh: 噩梦裂开伤口!，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Dream tear open wounds! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 魇梦受创惨叫!，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Enmu howls in pain! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 魇梦皮开肉绽!，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Enmu flesh torn! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 魇梦哀嚎受伤!，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Enmu cries in pain! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 魇梦伤痕累累!，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Enmu scarred! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 魇梦气息奄奄!，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Enmu faints! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 魇梦痛得扭曲!，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Enmu twists in pain! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 魇梦命悬一线!，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Enmu hanging by a thread! — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 魇梦奄奄一息!，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Enmu on death's door! — and the void makes it worse.
